description: Continue minimum-distortion positional unions to the first scored boundary
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,085 parameters at 99.040000%, a +0.040000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 19 prior macro-attempts in this family and 21 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0076, whose 20 checkpoint-migrated nearest positional unions moved the frontier from 2,105 to 2,085 parameters while retaining 99.04%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0075/micro-0001, an implementation error before training or scoring caused by a malformed source splice, repaired in attempt-0076. Hypothesis: further parameterization-preserving unions of the numerically closest learned positional scalar groups can remove parameters while preserving the checkpoint closely enough to qualify. Candidate ordering is ascending absolute difference between current group values, recomputed after each accepted union; this is more informative than the nearest untested alternative because the selected candidate is the minimum-distortion remaining union. Each micro-trial changes one union and is accepted or rolled back solely by run_attempt.py. Stop on the first scored failure because it closes this declared greedy path, on any reproducible error for inspection, or when no pair remains. The cap of 478 covers all possible unions among the 479 current positional groups. Compute budget: at most 478 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 10 wall-clock hours, with the first qualifying stop condition taking precedence.
summary: No micro-trial was recorded. Before source archival, training, or verification, sandboxed Git-index access failed after the runner created micro-0001; the permitted rerun then encountered that pre-existing directory and could not reuse it. This is an infrastructure error, not capacity evidence. Frontier remained 2,085 parameters at 99.04%; 0 accepted, 0 scored failures, 0 training compute.
